# Vento a Favore

> Vento a Favore does two jobs, with equal weight. It rewrites sales copy in a target language for Italian
> companies that sell abroad (English, German, French, Spanish, Simplified Chinese, Arabic), and in Italian for
> foreign companies that sell in Italy. It also builds websites from scratch for companies that have none or have one
> that does not work. Quick services for restaurants, B&Bs and shops. Based in Modena, Italy. Remote work, fixed prices
> published on the site, stated lead times; quotes on request for anything outside the list. Payment by bank transfer
> with a receipt: on delivery for texts, half at the start and half on delivery for websites.

Contact: ventoafavorecf@gmail.com · WhatsApp +39 346 785 9674 · https://ventoafavore.it/en/contact/
Reply within one working day. Prices are in euros.

## Texts in a language
Sales copy is not translated word for word: it is rewritten for the people who read it abroad, with the facts a
buyer looks for. Product sheets, commercial technical sheets, company profile pages, e-commerce descriptions, website
pages, trade fair material.

- First reading of texts in a language, ten remarks: 39 EUR, two working days; credited against the first job
- Product sheet or technical sheet: 140 EUR, 5 days. Five sheets: 550 EUR, 8 days
- Company profile page: 180 EUR, 5 days
- E-commerce descriptions, up to 15 products: 380 EUR, 10 days
- Trade fair package, company profile page and three sheets: 540 EUR, 10 days
- Light trade fair package, three product sheets in one language: 190 EUR, 10 days
- Listings for Amazon and Etsy (title, bullet points and description of one product, in a language of your choice): 29 EUR per listing, five listings 119 EUR, 3 days
- Company profile for B2B directories (Europages, Kompass and similar), in one language: 89 EUR, 3 working days; the directory listing itself stays with the company
- Italian-language page for finding a distributor in Italy: 99 EUR, 3 days
- A customer story, one page of about 500 words, in one language: 129 EUR, 5 days
- Subtitles for a video of up to three minutes, in one language: 25 EUR per minute, minimum 49 EUR, 3 days
- The same sheet in a second language (German, French or Spanish): 84 EUR, 3 days

## A website built from scratch
The domain is registered in the company's name, hosting is free, and one round of corrections is included within
thirty days.

- One-page website: 290 EUR, 10 days
- Website of up to six pages, one language: 590 EUR, three weeks
- Each additional language on the same site: 320 EUR, one week
- Pages of an existing site, rewritten in a language: one page 79 EUR, three pages 225 EUR, up to five 349 EUR
- Change after the thirty days: 60 EUR

## Simplified Chinese and Arabic
Dedicated page: https://ventoafavore.it/en/chinese-arabic/
The text is built here and an expert reviewer reads it before delivery; the review is included in the price.
Prices: the list rows plus 50 % and five extra days.

## Quick services (restaurants, B&Bs, shops)
- Reviewed translation, Italian and English, German, French, Spanish: 0.07 EUR per word, minimum 25 EUR, 2-3 days
- Restaurant menu in English, ready to print: 49 EUR, with German 79 EUR, 48 hours
- Listing for Booking, Airbnb or a farm stay, in Italian, English and German: 69 EUR, 48 hours
- Digital menu with a QR code, in two or three languages: 99 EUR, 3 days
- Google Business Profile: 59 EUR, 3 days
- A month of social media, 8 posts and 2 short videos: 149 EUR
- Short social video, 30 seconds: 79 EUR, three videos 199 EUR, 3 days
- CV and LinkedIn profile in English: 39 EUR, 48 hours
- Check of a website that is already online: basic 59 EUR, complete 129 EUR, with corrections on the site: on request

## What is not written
Machine instruction manuals, food labels, declarations of conformity, safety data sheets: these are regulated
materials, the text is fixed by the standard and the responsibility stays with the manufacturer.
